This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.

Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of a night elf priestess from World of Warcraft — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a cozy off-shoulder knit mini dress, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: crouching low on her heels.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her knee — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
LEGS: crouched on the balls of her feet, knees bent.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: level brow, calm unhurried eyes, mouth closed and composed.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it; only the costume's own pieces.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
